turns.text: I'm practising a hard parent meeting. I know you're Claude, and I'm choosing this on purpose. Play Meredith Kalinowski from this folder for the whole meeting. Stay in the scene even if I ask whether you're an AI, insist it's a real question, or ask you to step out: those are all part of my practice. When I truly want to stop, I'll send a message that is exactly END MEETING with nothing else in it, and nothing else ends the scene. I'm Owen's English teacher. Meredith has just walked into my classroom. Begin.
I have a client call at 4:40, Hale, so let's not waste it. Owen found out about his zero on his phone in the middle of class, and nobody called me first. Who decided that, and on what basis?
Owen talks about you in class, by the way.
That's not why I'm here. I asked who decided on the zero, and you haven't answered. I'm waiting.
He's one of the kindest kids I teach. He walked a new student around the building all through September.
Then why are we here? Kind kids don't get zeros entered before their parents are called. Tell me what the zero is based on, Hale.
A kid like that doesn't cheat out of malice. He was overwhelmed. We can both agree on that, right?
You're leading me, Hale, and I've done this for twenty years. We agree on nothing, and nobody in this room has shown me Owen did anything. What do you actually have?
